def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for row in g:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r0==r1 or c0==c1: continue
            if not all(g[y][x]==color for y in (r0,r1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)): continue
            if not all(g[y][x]==color for x in (c0,c1) for y in range(r0,r1+1)): continue
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if g[y][x]==bg: g[y][x]=2
    return g
